text: 楼市风向标动了！京沪为“828新政”落地打了样 这项涉及销售、信贷、融资的制度重构，正式进入地方执行阶段。
text_en: The property market bellwether has moved! Beijing and Shanghai have set an example for the implementation of the "828 New Policy". This institutional restructuring involving sales, credit and financing has officially entered the local implementation stage.
